Hi Jordan / Samir —

Thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: clinical note summarization + structured extraction for downstream analytics.
- Data volume: ~50k new documents/day, peak batch imports up to 200k.
- Key constraints: PII handling, VPC/private deployment for PHI, sub-100ms inference target for short requests, batch throughput for nightly processing.

Next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra teams where our solutions engineers will walk through architecture, integration patterns, and performance/quantization tradeoffs. Proposed agenda (draft):
1) Goals & success criteria (10 min)
2) Data flows & security (15 min)
3) Model selection, quantization, and latency expectations (20 min)
4) Serving topology & autoscaling (15 min)
5) Integration plan, rollout, and next steps (10 min)

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue, Jul 6: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
- Wed, Jul 7: 10:00–11:30 (preferred)

Can you confirm who from your ML/infra/security teams should attend and which of the windows works best? I attached the discovery notes from today and a short draft agenda.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.
